title: Seat comfort and control usability notes
summary: This topic combines seat comfort remarks with broader comments about vehicle controls and feature familiarity, with many excerpts too vague to assign clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention satisfaction with the vehicle overall, growing comfort using it, and favorable impressions of past BMW ownership.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe harder-to-use controls and discomfort with hands-off steering behavior rather than a single consistent seat issue.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the seat base, backrest, and lumbar area could be improved even though the seats are not described as severely uncomfortable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention comfort, design familiarity, selected features, and learning vehicle functions without enough explicit opinion to classify them reliably.

limitations: The sample for known sentiment is small relative to the number of undetermined excerpts, so concrete sentiment themes are limited.
This topic cluster mixes seat comfort, steering or controller usability, and general feature-learning comments rather than one tightly focused subject.
Several provided fragments are broad vehicle impressions or factual notes, which limits confidence in summarizing a single product aspect.
